# Present Simple

## What you will learn
Present Simple describes habits and general facts. Use the base verb with I/you/we/they; add -s/-es with he/she/it. Questions use do/does.

## Example in context
I play tennis on Sundays. She plays tennis on Sundays. Does she play?

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
After does, use the base verb: Does she play?, not Does she plays?

## Practice and reflection
Complete: He ___ (study) English every day.
**Model answer:** studies

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
